title: EvidenceRef
description: Typed reference to evidence provenance without embedding arbitrary raw evidence.

contract_version.description: Contract version identifier for the EvidenceRef schema instance.

evidence_ref_id.description: Stable identifier for the evidence reference.

source_collector.description: Approved collector name that produced the evidence.

evidence_kind.description: Kind classification for the evidence artifact.

captured_at.description: Timestamp at which the evidence was captured.

local_path_hint.description: Local-only path hint for evidence provenance.

hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the referenced evidence.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification for the evidence reference.
